parties:
Government of Bangladesh and others ------ Appellants
Vs.
Md Abdul Halim Miah and others ------ Respondents
full_judgment: 24. The writ petitioner-respondents further argued that the judicial review by the High Court Division is a basic structure theory that contemplates that no amendment of the Constitution effecting the basic structure or feature of the Constitution is permissible and the plea of basic structure would be available if the ouster clause of Article 117(2) was introduced in the Constitution by way of amendment. Article 117(2) has been originally incorporated in our Constitution conferring the power of judicial review subject to the limitation of Article 117(2).
